name: Vals releases an Access to Justice benchmark for legal-aid chats
title: Vals releases an Access to Justice benchmark for legal-aid chats
summary: Vals and NextLadder released Access to Justice, 252 scenarios drawn from legal-aid queries and scored with expert rubrics. Qwen 3.8 Max leads at 76.4 percent of criteria. Models explain the law more often than they name local help, and free-tier models scored about the same as premium ones.

appearances.title: Vals publishes an Access to Justice legal benchmark
appearances.summary: Vals AI and Next Ladder released an Access to Justice benchmark for helping people with legal problems without a lawyer. Qwen 3.8 Max leads at 76.4 percent of expert rubric criteria. MiniMax M3.1 Flash lands within the margin of error of Claude Sonnet 5.5 at about 1/36 the price, and free-tier chatbots score about as well as premium ones.
